name: Adventi – Lead Generator Advent Calendar
author: adventi

sections.description:
Adventi is the easiest way to add a fully functional advent calendar to your WordPress site — perfect for Christmas campaigns, lead generation, coupon reveals and seasonal engagement.

With this free version you can:

  • Display a 12-day advent calendar
  • Add custom titles, descriptions, coupon codes and download links
  • Collect leads directly inside your WordPress admin
  • Choose between built-in Christmas-themed color palettes
  • Track total leads and today’s leads in your dashboard
  • Customize all button texts, labels and messages (multilingual-friendly)
  • Trigger the popup on any page using the shortcode [adventi]
  • Benefit from full translation support through the WordPress i18n system

Designed especially for:

  • Businesses and marketers running seasonal campaigns
  • E-commerce stores offering coupon codes or downloads
  • Anyone wanting a fun and interactive Christmas advent experience

A future optional version will be available on shopadventi.com with:

  • Additional customization options
  • Extra color palettes
  • Snow animations
  • Calendar day-count selector
  • Additional lead fields such as phone, address, terms text, and acceptance checkbox

The plugin installs in minutes and works with any theme.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/adventi or install directly from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to Adventi → Settings.
  4. Add your starting date
  5. Add your gifts: titles, descriptions, coupon codes or download URLs.
  6. Select a color palette and enter your start date.
  7. Insert the shortcode [adventi] on any page.
  8. Visit the page, complete the form, and the calendar will unlock automatically.
  9. View your collected leads under Adventi → Leads.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin store leads?

Yes. Every user who submits the Adventi form is stored with their name, email and date.

Can I download the leads?

The free version stores leads inside WordPress. Lead export tools will be available in a future optional version.

Can I change the design of the calendar?

Yes! Adventi includes color palettes and fully customizable texts.

Is each day locked by date?

Yes. Each day becomes available based on your selected start date.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. The calendar uses JavaScript-based unlocking, so it works with caching enabled.
